The quote is in the keynote text word for word: "The percentage of industrial control systems that will include analytics and AI inference capabilities at the edge will increase by six-fold in the next four years." The transcript itself prints no date. The file was created on 2021-11-02 (09:16, Pacific time), which matches the reported date.

It doesn't fit the deployment wording either: a product that is an AI system, with a claim about what it will do or how widely it ships. The rule says a truly borderline case stays out and is logged as borderline.
3. **Date or span: passes.** "In the next four years" is a span counted from the day it was said, so about November 2025.
